scope: Additive over COACHINGCORE-V1-RUN-CALIBRATION-FREEZE-1. No V1RC value, gate, computation or file changes. Nonclinical recreational adults, synthetic data only. paceInsights.athleteConfirmedRevision adds a separate effective-band layer for THRESHOLD_CONTROLLED only, conditional on escalation E1.

forecast.start: The V1RC current estimate of the plan's event, its unrounded {lower, central, upper} as V1RC computes them (after any Q8 down adjustment). No forecast when that estimate is UNAVAILABLE or not shown.

rules.when: No report for a planned run session
actual.completed === true (the engine's reading; under the RWS amendment completion of a distance-target session is the distance)
Not completed and RWS actual.steps with at least one WORK or STEADY step
rules.c: sum(w_s * m_s) / sum(w_s) over WORK and STEADY steps
rules.w_s: the step's planning share: target seconds for a TIME step; the midpoint of its estimated seconds for a DISTANCE step
rules.m_s: extent only, never intensity: 1 if targetMet === true; a step that is one repetition of a repeated block and not met: 0; any other WORK or STEADY step not met (continuous TIME or DISTANCE): min(1, measured extent / target extent) in its own unit (seconds or metres) when measured, else 0

rules.when: Not completed, no usable steps, distance-target session with a recorded distance

rules.c: min(actual minutes, planned minutes) / planned minutes
rules.note: r1 reading; 0 if no extent is recorded

adherence.weekly: a_w = sum(planned minutes x c) / sum(planned minutes), planned minutes = prescription.durationMinutes (the canonical planning dose)
adherence.weekWithoutPlannedRunMinutes: Not counted (0 credit) and left out of the mean
adherence.futureMeanOf: a (the weekly adherence), then f applied once
adherence.scope: Credit for the forecast only. It never feeds dose, progression, the engine's adherence or completion judgments, or any G03 reading (Product/UX + Data own those).

response.pair: One pair: A = the earliest eligible reference dated on or after (plan start - 28 days); B = the current V1RC standard reference. Same kind (RACE_RESULT with RACE_RESULT; TIME_TRIAL or FIELD_TEST with TIME_TRIAL or FIELD_TEST). Neither presumed, SUBMAXIMAL_LOWER_BOUND, unknown effort, OUTSIDE_MODEL_POPULATION, nor longer than the half marathon. No declared break of 7 days or more between A and B.
response.sigma: The V1RC margin of each reference (tier margin plus any slow-runner margin) / 1.2816
response.update: R_obs = ln(T10_A / T10_B) / dGamma; var = (sigma_A^2 + sigma_B^2) / dGamma^2; R_c = (R_c0/s0^2 + R_obs/var) / (1/s0^2 + 1/var); sd = (1/s0^2 + 1/var)^(-1/2); then R_c clipped to [0, 1]. No pair: R_c = 0.5, sd = 0.3.

slowdown.comparedWith: the most recent eligible same-kind reference dated before B (pair rules except spacing)
slowdown.effect: g = 0 until a later reference is not 3% slower

formulas.H_eff: sum of f(a_w) over credited counted plan weeks (fc.weekCredit); each future counted week before RACE_WEEK earns f(future adherence of the range): 1 for the plan scenario, f(mean a) for the observed forecast
formulas.g: Gamma(start of RACE_WEEK) - Gamma(reference date), per range; 0 for the marathon, after a slowdown, or while a Q8 down factor is in force

forecast.rounding: V1RC roundOutwardSeconds (5K/10K 15 s, half/marathon 60 s): low floored, high ceiled, central to nearest
forecast.width: rounded high / rounded low - 1; shown only if <= wMax, else TOO_UNCERTAIN_TO_SHOW; never narrowed
forecast.shownUntil: Live ranges: the day before RACE_WEEK starts. In RACE_WEEK: only fc.raceWeek.

confidence.withoutGain: the current estimate tier, at most MODERATE

forecast.recompute: At the week boundary only; withdrawal applies at once
withdrawal: declared break of 14 days or more
event estimate unavailable or not shown
extension or ESTIMATE boundary not enabled

requiredText.observedForecast: If you keep training as you have over the last <n> weeks, <race> on <date>: <low>-<high>. The slower end assumes no further improvement. Not a promise.
requiredText.planScenario: If you follow the plan from now on, <race> on <date>: <low>-<high>. The slower end assumes no further improvement. Not a promise.
requiredText.coincide: If you keep training as you have over the last <n> weeks, in line with the plan, <race> on <date>: <low>-<high>. The slower end assumes no further improvement. Not a promise.
requiredText.basis: Based on your <reference> of <date>; individual results vary. A plausible span, not a probability.
requiredText.raceWeek: Forecast of <date>, not updated in race week: <low>-<high>. For pacing, use your current estimate and its caution.
requiredText.goal: Your goal <time> is faster than / within / slower than this range.
requiredText.notYetInWindow: A forecast appears from <availableFrom>, 16 weeks before the race. Until then, your current estimate.
requiredText.marathon: Your current marathon estimate, assuming the block's long runs are completed: <low>-<high>. No further improvement is assumed for the marathon. Not a promise.

weekCredit.atReferenceDate: Gamma(d) at a reference date d credits every counted plan week whose first day is on or before d: the week that contains the reference is credited at its observed adherence (a reference dated before the plan credits nothing).
weekCredit.atWeekStart: Gamma(t) at a week start t (t_now = start of the week in force; t_RW = start of RACE_WEEK) credits every counted plan week whose last day is before t.
weekCredit.pair: Gamma(t_A) and Gamma(t_B) of the response pair use atReferenceDate.
weekCredit.referenceWeekAdherence: Always observed: V1RC reads a reference only from the week after it is dated and recorded, so the week containing it is complete.

decomposition.O: ln(T10_A / T10_B): observed gain, already inside the V1RC current estimate; never added
decomposition.U: Gamma(t_now) - Gamma(t_ref): executed weeks after the reference, at observed adherence, not yet measured
decomposition.F: Gamma(t_RW) - Gamma(t_now): counted weeks still to come before RACE_WEEK, at the range's future adherence
decomposition.g: U + F = Gamma(t_RW) - Gamma(t_ref); 0 for the marathon, after a slowdown, or while a Q8 down factor is in force (both ranges)

observedForecast.futureAdherence: mean a of the last <= 4 completed counted weeks, then f once

ranges.coincide: If f(mean a) = 1, or the rounded [low, central, high] of both ranges are identical: one range, kind OBSERVED_FORECAST, coincidesWithPlanScenario true
ranges.eachRange: Own width test against wMax, shown whole or TOO_UNCERTAIN_TO_SHOW, never narrowed; same slow edge (current estimate upper), same R_c and R_hi, same g = 0 rules
ranges.presentation: When both are shown: the observed forecast first, the plan scenario as the conditional alternative; the plan scenario is never the headline while the observed forecast is SHOWN; range first, central never alone. If only the observed forecast passes the width test, only it is shown.
ranges.zMeaning: z = 1.2816 is a spread constant on the response prior; never displayed, never described as a coverage, a percentage or a probability

retiredFlags.ASSUMES_PLAN_FOLLOWED: replaced by the range kind PLAN_SCENARIO

notYetInWindow.availableFrom: the first plan week start on or after (race date - 112 days)

raceWeek.frozenForecast: The observed forecast that was SHOWN for the last week before RACE_WEEK (including the coincide case), frozen: never recomputed, no gain added
raceWeek.shownThrough: the day before race day; never on race day or in race-day mode

display.position: after the V1RC current estimate, its race-day text and its pacing caution
display.label: Forecast of <date>; not updated in race week

notShownIf: the observed forecast was not SHOWN for that week (TOO_UNCERTAIN_TO_SHOW, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_ENOUGH_HISTORY, plan scenario only)
its g was 0 (it equals the current estimate)
the V1RC reference in force differs from the one it was computed from, its confidence tier changed, or a Q8 down factor took effect since

forecast.marathonPresentation: Shown only as the current marathon estimate with requiredText.marathon; never labelled a forecast; no plan scenario, no observed forecast, no race-week frozen forecast and no goal relation to a range (the V1RC goal comparison only)

goal.primary: The V1RC goal comparison with the current estimate, unchanged and always first

relationToRange.against: the rounded displayed low and high of each SHOWN range, inclusive (low <= goal <= high is INSIDE_RANGE); never the central
relationToRange.perRange: stated beside its own range under that range's condition

forecast.unavailableGuidance: Unavailable, too-uncertain and not-yet-in-window states state the V1RC reason and name only existing V1RC routes: report a race result at the event distance (never a prompt to enter one), or the P3 field test only when assessment.status is OFFERED. Never instruct a longer run, more training, a test P3 does not offer, or a race entry; the plan's own sessions are the route to the endurance gates.
forbiddenInCopy: a coverage or percentage attached to a range
success or failure styling of the goal relation

paceInsights.comparable: V1RC comparableRun (no HEAT, HILLY, TRAIL, WIND_STRONG; no treadmill; GPS not poor), completed, RPE inside the cue, every work bout >= 5 min
paceInsights.classify: As V1RC Q8 against the band in force in the execution's own week: FASTER if fast edge pace / pace - 1 > 0.015; SLOWER if pace / slow edge pace - 1 > 0.015; else INSIDE

exceptional.measure: d = ln(band midpoint pace / execution pace), band of its own week
exceptional.rule: |d - median(d)| > max(3 * MAD(d), 0.05): shown, never voted

outcomes.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: fewer than 3 non-exceptional or span < 14 days

actions.q8NoRoomOr5K10K: Unchanged for HALF_MARATHON_EFFORT, MARATHON_EFFORT, FIVE_K_EFFORT and TEN_K_EFFORT: OFFER_V1RC_FIELD_TEST if P3 offers one now, else SUGGEST_REPORTING_A_RACE
actions.thresholdQ8AtCap: OFFER_V1RC_FIELD_TEST first if P3 offers one now; ATHLETE_CONFIRMED_PACE_REVISION when athleteConfirmedRevision.offeredWhen holds (only after E1); else SUGGEST_REPORTING_A_RACE

voteMinWorkBoutMinutes.note: Unchanged from r1; reps of 3-5 min never vote in any domain (A3 sub-question refused)

athleteConfirmedRevision.conditionalOn: Escalation E1 recorded by Chief/Founder; if it is not, this block is inert and r1 F9 applies unchanged

refusedDomains.FIVE_K_EFFORT: race-pace domain; rep pace above critical speed is not a capacity readout
refusedDomains.HALF_MARATHON_EFFORT: race-pace domain used for race-pace touches and next to race-day pacing
refusedDomains.MARATHON_EFFORT: race-pace domain; the marathon is where a fast estimate costs most

offeredWhen: Insights state IMPROVING for the domain (r1 rules), computed at the week boundary, every execution classified against the effective band in force in its own week
V1RC Q8 factor for the domain in force at its +0.045 cap; band AVAILABLE with basis DERIVED_FROM_CAPACITY (never an observed P2 band)

every voting execution: comparable (r1), completed, RPE inside the cue and response compatible (V1RC onTarget), measurement TRACK, or GPS with quality GOOD (not merely not poor), every work bout >= 5 min and total work >= 15 min (V1RC Q8 rule)
every voting execution dated on or after the effective date of the previous revision step in the domain (no execution supports two steps)
no harder-than-cue execution of the domain among the window's executions, and no adverse response on any run in the 7 days before the offer
plan mode EASY; no hold; no declared break >= 7 days in the window; warning-sign screen not REQUIRED; experience not NONE
not in TAPER, RACE_WEEK or POST_EVENT, and not within 14 days before the race date
at least 28 days since the effective date of the previous step, or since a revision ended
athleteConfirmedRevision.offerOrder: When P3 offers a field test now, the test is offered first and the revision is the alternative, with the statement that a test or race updates every pace and estimate, the revision only this band

step.rule: min(median over all voting executions of (effective fast edge pace / execution pace - 1), 0.02, 0.03 - revision in force)

athleteConfirmedRevision.application: Speed terms, as V1RC Q8: effective fast edge = paceEdge((1 / V1RC fastSecondsPerKm) x (1 + R), 5); effective slow edge = max(paceEdge((1 / V1RC slowSecondsPerKm) x (1 + R), 5), effective fast edge + 10); paceEdge = round to 0.1 s/km then up to the next multiple of 5 s/km (V1RC); R = revision in force; the V1RC band in force already includes its Q8 factor
athleteConfirmedRevision.confirmation: Athlete-confirmed only; never applied without an explicit yes; declining has no consequence and the same evidence is not offered again
athleteConfirmedRevision.effectiveFrom: the next week boundary after confirmation
endsAtOnce: any V1RC withdrawal (hold, declared break >= 7 days, WALK_JOG/RESTART/RETURN mode, warning-sign screen REQUIRED)
one comparable execution of the domain harder than the cue
two consecutive comparable executions of the domain at an in-cue effort more than 1.5% slower than the effective slow edge
Insights state SLOWER_THAN_BAND, or a V1RC Q8 down step, in the domain
an adverse response on any run
athleteConfirmedRevision.endsAtOnceMeans: for sessions not yet started; the band reverts to the V1RC band in force
athleteConfirmedRevision.lapses: At the first week boundary 56 days or more after its latest step, unless the domain state then is STABLE or IMPROVING against the effective band
athleteConfirmedRevision.changesOnly: the THRESHOLD_CONTROLLED band as shown and as read by the RWS format selector (one band source: effectiveBand); the RWS envelope checks E1-E4 unchanged
athleteConfirmedRevision.label: ATHLETE_CONFIRMED_REVISION, with the size in percent of the V1RC band and the date; effort governs
athleteConfirmedRevision.copyMustNot: say or imply fitter, faster race times, a new capacity or a test result; invite running faster than the cue
athleteConfirmedRevision.requiredText: Your last <n> threshold sessions at the target effort were faster than your band. Set your threshold band <x>% faster from <date>? Effort still governs, and you can undo this at any time. Your race estimates do not change.
